intro: Wherever work happens, Bravo fits in. From workstations to meeting rooms, Bravo delivers ergonomic support that keeps you comfortable and focused, no matter what your workday demands.

features.title: One family, every need covered
features.text: From focused desk work to guest seating, Bravo’s complete range—including Mid Back, High Back, and Visitor options—ensures every corner of your office is covered with comfort and style.

features.title: Comfort that lasts beyond the workday
features.text: Say goodbye to seat fatigue. With a thicker foam cushion and form-sensing mesh, our chair offers the perfect balance of softness and support—helping you stay comfortable, even during long hours at your desk.

features.title: Stay cool, stay focused
features.text: Wrapped in soft fabric and moulded PU foam, our backrest provides all-day support. The contoured lumbar design cradles your spine, reducing strain and keeping you at ease through long hours.

name: Bravo Full Back Knitted Fabric Workstation Chair
